items.summary: Arlington Heights 内の公共 ROW 地中埋設替え工事(既設地中ケーブル約2,290フィートを方向性掘削工法で新設・旧ケーブル撤去、新設電柱設置。施工は Intren)。
items.verbatim:
Intren to replace approx. 2,290 feet of underground cable using the directional 
bore method in existing easement/ROW and abandon old cable. Install new utility pole.
**Electrical Crews will follow within several weeks of bore completion** / Utility Underground - Public ROW / Public ROW
